description: Single Source of Truth for YouTube Music metadata cleaning patterns and keywords across languages.

whitespace.description: Matches whitespace and non-breaking Unicode space variants.

timeDuration.description: Matches mm:ss or hh:mm:ss track duration formats.

trackCount.description: Matches track counts across multi-lingual interfaces.

viewKeyword.pattern: (?:aufruf|view|vue|visualiza|visualizz|просмотр|перегляд|wyświetle|görüntüleme|weergaven|visning|katselukert|zhlédnut|zhliadnut|megtekintés|vizionar|προβολ|pregled|צפי|مشاهد|ditonton|lượt\s*xem|回視聴|次观看|次觀看|조회|ครั้ง)
viewKeyword.description: Matches view count keywords across 25+ YouTube Music languages.

timeKeyword.pattern: (?:^vor\s|\bago$|^il y a\b|^hace\s|^há\s|\bfa$|назад$|тому$|önce$|temu$|előtt$|sedan$|siden$|sitten$|yang lalu$|^před\s|^pred\s|^acum\s|^πριν\s|^pre\s|לפני|قبل|trước$|ที่แล้ว$|年前|前$|전$)
timeKeyword.description: Matches relative upload time prefixes and suffixes across languages.

dateUnit.description: Matches time/date units (year, month, week, day, hour, minute).

relativePast.description: Matches past relative words across languages.

likeKeyword.description: Matches like, reaction, and subscriber count keywords across languages.

bulletSplit.description: Matches bullet delimiters separating artist, album, and views.

trailingYear.description: Matches trailing 4-digit release year at the end of string (state-free, no global flag).

leadingExplicit.description: Matches leading explicit badge at beginning of title/artist.

trailingPunctuation.description: Matches trailing punctuation, dashes, or bullets left over after string stripping.
